questions.stem: Consider the following: how many bijections are there from a collection with 4 objects onto itself?

questions.hint: A bijection on a finite set is a permutation.

questions.explanation: Reflexivity requires exactly the diagonal pair (x,x) for each of the 4 elements, and no other pairs are forced, so the minimum reflexive relation has 4 ordered pairs. The required result is 4.
questions.hint: Reflexivity forces one diagonal pair per element.

questions.stem: In the set model described, altogether how many unordered tuples of distinct elements are there in a set with 8 elements?
questions.explanation: The number of unordered pairs of distinct elements is the binomial coefficient C(8,2), which equals 8 times (8 minus 1) divided by 2, namely 28. The required result is 28.
questions.hint: Use a binomial coefficient for unordered pairs.
